claims.claim: William Stanley Jevons published The Coal Question in 1865.
claims.source_title: W. Stanley Jevons, “The Coal Question,” 1865 – Energy History
claims.supporting_quote: In his 1865 book, “The Coal Question; An Inquiry Concerning the Progress of the Nation, and the Probable Exhaustion of Our Coal Mines,” British economist William Stanley Jevons warned that Britain would exhaust the coal supplies that were fueling its growth and prosperity.
